summary: Ten blocks in the soft-blue style: employer-brand head with an award badge, a podcast video, four growth cards, a jobs link band (jobs open on an external board), rewards in three cards, referral, a four-step hiring process, stories, moments gallery and a closing call. Needs an employer award, 4 to 7 reward items, 4 hiring steps and event photos.

sections.note: pale-blue ground; title and lead with a filled and an outlined button left; a tilted award certificate badge on a faded team photo right
rounded card: heading, paragraph and a pill button left; a video player with a two-item playlist right
centered heading and lead; four white cards, each a small icon, bold blue title and two lines
rounded band with an illustration on each side, one heading and a Browse all jobs button (the roles live on an external board)
three cards: a tick list of pay and benefits, leave days with an illustration, and an accordion of awards
referral band: heading, line and button left, people illustration right
four numbered step cards with an illustration, title and one line, then a button
culture stories: three cards with a photo, round tag, date and title
moments gallery with two or three photos and a heading
closing panel with heading and a button
